text:
Morgan: FYI — canary roll (canary-id=rc-14) pushed 03:15 UTC; noticed jump in structured-output validation rejects on the canary route.
Deploy-bot: alert: function_validation_rejects spike; 5m rate=1.2% (baseline 0.03%). top-models: redwood-open-7b, redwood-qa-compact. link: https://console/redwood/alerts/123 
Tara: ouch. are these hard rejects (count towards quota/billing)?
Morgan: looks like schema rejection during toolhook parse. stack shows:
```json
{"error":"invalid_tool_output","details":"expected object, got array","route":"canary","model":"redwood-open-7b"}
```
Alex: proposal: soft-validate for canary traffic — route to fallback model variant and surface a 'soft_reject' flag in response. don't bill tokens for rejected outputs. add metric: reject_class (schema|parse|timeout).
Ravi: +1 but need to update billing pipeline. we already have billing_event.reason, can add 'validation_reject' and ensure cost=0 for those ops. also, important: quota accounting vs routing cost — we shouldn't charge customer requests that didn't produce usable tokens.
Sam: Console UX: On canary dashboard show 'validation_reject_rate' and a 'soft_fail' toggle per-route. Also let SEs opt-in to capture full payloads for 30min for triage (with auto-redact).
Tara: telemetry sampling — do we increase sampling for these rejects? current sample is 1/1000; we should bump to 1/100 for rejects and 1/10 for failed toolhooks tied to enterprise customers.
Morgan: can we add routing override header for testing? e.g., `X-Redwood-Debug-Routing: permissive`
Alex: pseudoconfig:
```yaml
routes:
  canary:
    validation_policy: soft_fail
    sample_rejects: 0.1
    fallback_route: stable-legacy
    billing: do_not_charge_on_rejects
```
Ravi: ops concern: if we soft-fail and fall back we might mask regressions. need a dashboard tile that shows 'fallback_rate' and links to sampled payloads.
Sam: agree. also add alerting: when validation_reject_rate > 0.5% for 10m -> pager oncall-eng-platform.
Morgan: decision for now: enable soft_fail on canary for 2 hours, sample rejects at 10%, create dashboard tile + alert. billing: zero-charge for reject events (engineering-only flag until legal signs off). owner: @alex to implement, @ravi for billing hook, @sam for dashboard, @tara to coordinate sampling policy.
Alex: I'll PR the route change and add metric emitter (metric: validation.rejects{route,model,severity}).
Deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-reroute-v2 -> 03:42 UTC :thumbsup: 
Sam: created dashboard tile https://console/dash/tiles/val-rejects-canary
Morgan: logging note: redact keys: email, ssn, token before storing payloads. implement deterministic hashing for ids.
Tara: thanks — follow-up meeting 10am to review first hour metrics.
Morgan: :raised_hands:
